rationale: Ratchet, not a target: set a few points below the coverage measured on 2026-11-20 so the gate blocks regressions without failing today. Web UI (Vitest 5, v8 provider, web/src excluding test files): statements 92.23, branches 87.65, functions 90.32, lines 93.6. The Rust workspace is not gated: cargo-llvm-cov was not available where this was set up, so no number was measured and none is guessed; .github/workflows/coverage-gate.yml has a manual, report-only Rust job, and a threshold belongs here only after it has produced one. The scripts under scripts/ are reported, not gated. Raise these as coverage grows; never lower them.
